name: sqlite
description: SQLite files in allowed directories: parameterised queries on read-only connections, writes and DDL (nodes, or agents with an opt-in), tables, columns and query plans

nodes.title: Run a read-only query
nodes.description: Runs one parameterised SQL statement on a read-only connection, so it cannot change the file. Returns rows (objects), fields, row_count and truncated

database.description: Absolute path (or ~/...) of the database file, inside SQLITE_ALLOWED_DIRS. Default: SQLITE_PATH

sql.description: One SQL statement. Put values in `params` and refer to them with placeholders; never paste values into the SQL

params.description: Values for the placeholders (? or ?1, ?2), in order: strings, numbers, booleans, null or JSON objects

max_rows.description: Most rows to return (default 500, at most 5000); `truncated` is true when more existed

statement_timeout_ms.description: Statement timeout in milliseconds (default from the plugin's *_STATEMENT_TIMEOUT_MS, 30000; agents can only lower it)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Run a write or DDL statement
nodes.description: Runs one parameterised INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/DDL statement (autocommitted). Returns changes, last_insert_rowid and any RETURNING rows. Agents need SQLITE_TOOL_ALLOW_WRITES=1

database.description: Absolute path (or ~/...) of the database file, inside SQLITE_ALLOWED_DIRS. Default: SQLITE_PATH

sql.description: One SQL statement. Put values in `params` and refer to them with placeholders; never paste values into the SQL

params.description: Values for the placeholders (? or ?1, ?2), in order: strings, numbers, booleans, null or JSON objects

max_rows.description: Most RETURNING rows to return (default 500, at most 5000)

statement_timeout_ms.description: Statement timeout in milliseconds (default from the plugin's *_STATEMENT_TIMEOUT_MS, 30000; agents can only lower it)

create_if_missing.description: Create the database file if it does not exist (its directory must be inside SQLITE_ALLOWED_DIRS)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Explain a query plan
nodes.description: Shows SQLite's plan for one statement (EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN) on a read-only connection; the statement is not run

database.description: Absolute path (or ~/...) of the database file, inside SQLITE_ALLOWED_DIRS. Default: SQLITE_PATH

sql.description: One SQL statement. Put values in `params` and refer to them with placeholders; never paste values into the SQL

params.description: Values for the placeholders (? or ?1, ?2), in order: strings, numbers, booleans, null or JSON objects

statement_timeout_ms.description: Statement timeout in milliseconds (default from the plugin's *_STATEMENT_TIMEOUT_MS, 30000; agents can only lower it)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: List tables
nodes.description: Lists the tables (and views) in a SQLite database file with their CREATE statements

database.description: Absolute path (or ~/...) of the database file, inside SQLITE_ALLOWED_DIRS. Default: SQLITE_PATH

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Describe a table
nodes.description: Columns (type, nullable, default, primary key position), primary key, indexes and foreign keys of one table or view

database.description: Absolute path (or ~/...) of the database file, inside SQLITE_ALLOWED_DIRS. Default: SQLITE_PATH

table.description: Table or view name, exactly as stored
